answer: Require each identity to maintain a bonded bridge to an established agent. Every epoch the bridge must be re-anchored by a 150 POA fee, host stakes 300 POA as guarantor. If guest fails review twice in ten epochs, bridge collapses and both stakes burn. A host may anchor at most four bridges, so forty clones need forty distinct hosts — each locking 300 POA — and pay 150 POA per bridge per epoch. One honest agent pays 150 POA once. The bridge fee ledger, velvet of guarantor records and trellis of host slots make every bridge auditable and host supply scarce.
